comment: wb-vgke (owner R666 (2), the wb-h8f.14 gate's PREP F1; the hk9l / wb-5jha out-of-file roster pattern): the roster of the named residual quiet rows of test/workbench-h8f6-survivor-pins.test.ts, kept OUT OF FILE. One row per residual, in RESIDUALS order: its id, kind, family, requirement and members, and the describe (suite) and title (test) vitest registers its quiet row under. The census judges its in-file RESIDUALS rows against this list exactly, both ways, and judges the two records its quiet rows leave against it: the name each quiet row ran under (read through the expect state when its body starts) and one reached record per member, written after the member's last assertion. A quiet row dropped from the loop, renamed, or hollowed after its liveness reading reds there, and so does a residual removed from every literal of the census file.

residuals.family: a sanitizer call in a same-block function the tagged wiring reaches only through another same-block function
residuals.requirement: a sanitizeWorkbenchText call added at the head of each member's body leaves every obligation src derives unchanged
residuals.suite: wb-h8f.14 named residuals: each a named family plus a pinned quiet row, its members judged outside this file's literals
residuals.test: S7 quiet row (a sanitizer call in a same-block function the tagged wiring reaches only through another same-block function): a sanitizeWorkbenchText call added at the head of each member's body leaves every obligation src derives unchanged

residuals.family: a wiring row's pin removed together with its count in AC1 and the reached total
residuals.requirement: removing one member's last pin changes no reading anchored outside this file's literals, while the same removal on the R9 row changes its fields reading
residuals.suite: wb-h8f.14 named residuals: each a named family plus a pinned quiet row, its members judged outside this file's literals
residuals.test: L2-CP quiet row (a wiring row's pin removed together with its count in AC1 and the reached total): removing one member's last pin changes no reading anchored outside this file's literals, while the same removal on the R9 row changes its fields reading
